ClusterValidation.description: A reference-only pass never certifies uncomputed execution stages.
ClusterValidation.title: ClusterValidation

CommunicationEventExecution.description: Observed coverage, not a claim that one event alone caused each drop.
CommunicationEventExecution.title: CommunicationEventExecution

CommunicationFaultWindow.description: Inclusive iteration window; packet loss retains explicit global semantics.
CommunicationFaultWindow.title: CommunicationFaultWindow

ComputationQualityPolicy.description: Bounded offline solve budgets, not physical tolerances or a global optimum claim.
ComputationQualityPolicy.title: ComputationQualityPolicy

CoordinationIterationTrace.description:
Lightweight immutable replay evidence for one communication tick.

Epoch identifies the barrier being collected. References are AFTER this
tick's projection (unchanged if global_updated is false). Time is a separate
planning axis in hours, never a conversion of communication_tick.
CoordinationIterationTrace.title: CoordinationIterationTrace

CoordinationSnapshot.description:
One completed barrier update; row order is the order of `regions`.

The local plans consumed epoch k, and the new references/duals are for k+1.
`converged` certifies the aggregate convex problem only, never execution.
CoordinationSnapshot.title: CoordinationSnapshot

DispatchCapabilities.description:
One dispatch request's device participation, not physical nameplate data.

Disabled storage provides neither active nor reactive support, matching
existing central solvers. Its initial energy is held fixed.
DispatchCapabilities.title: DispatchCapabilities

DynamicTrackingPolicy.description: Offline response assessment parameters, shared with the synthetic plant.

source.default: 软件仿真动态判据：依据已记录的响应、爬坡、最长等待和连续确认参数；非现场验收定值
source.title: Source

DynamicTrackingPolicy.title: DynamicTrackingPolicy

ExecutionPolicy.description: Offline study tolerances, NOT customer-approved operating setpoints.

source.default: 软件仿真策略：工程限值、数值容差与分钟动态规则随结果记录；非现场验收定值
source.title: Source

ExecutionPolicy.title: ExecutionPolicy

MinuteReserveObservation.description: At a minute boundary, based only on the last completed device state.
MinuteReserveObservation.title: MinuteReserveObservation

ReactivePlanningPolicy.description: Study reserve and transition envelope; never expands physical Q authority.

source.default: 软件无功规划假设（参数随结果记录）；待现场动态与预测误差校准
source.title: Source

ReactivePlanningPolicy.title: ReactivePlanningPolicy

ReferenceEconomics.description: Aggregate reference accounting, explicitly NOT regional AC realization.
ReferenceEconomics.title: ReferenceEconomics

RegionalCoordinationTrace.description:
Coordinator's latest accepted proposal, never a device measurement.

Positive P/Q mean PCC import. Missing proposals remain None. Fresh means
eligible for this barrier epoch, including an unexpired buffered response.
Outage and local fallback are independent observations, not inferred from P.
RegionalCoordinationTrace.title: RegionalCoordinationTrace

RegionalPlanSnapshot.description: Owned immutable values of the local solve used in an ADMM update.
RegionalPlanSnapshot.title: RegionalPlanSnapshot

RenewableAccounting.description:
Chronological interval MW. Availability is AFTER the rated-MW bound.

Raw predictions remain diagnostics. Excess above rated availability is not
controllable curtailment. Tuples own their values and cannot mutate callers.
RenewableAccounting.title: RenewableAccounting

RollingUpdate.description: Information available before adoption, plus post-execution energy evidence.

forecast_basis.default: 同版本日内预测按窗口读取；反馈仅使用已执行状态，不读取未来分钟实绩
forecast_basis.title: Forecast Basis

RollingUpdate.title: RollingUpdate

ScenarioEventRecord.description: Stored event description; reading evidence does not authorize execution.
ScenarioEventRecord.title: ScenarioEventRecord

data_notice.title: Data Notice

SimulationRequestRecord.description: Recorded inputs, including historical combinations no longer executable.
SimulationRequestRecord.title: SimulationRequestRecord

StorageReservePolicy.title: StorageReservePolicy
